lines.en: Hi Marcus. What did you do last night?
lines.la: Salvē, Marce. Quid herī vesperī fēcistī?

lines.en: Last night? First, a battle with my son.
lines.la: Herī vesperī? Prīmum, proelium cum fīliō meō.

lines.en: That is: full of water, like after a bath.
lines.la: Id est: plēnus aquae, sīcut post balneum.

lines.en: Yes. Cheese is very dear to my wife.
lines.la: Ita. Cāseus uxōrī meae valdē cārus est.

lines.en: We sing it at Mass. And after Mass, we have lunch!
lines.la: Hoc in Missā cantāmus. Et post Missam, prandēmus!
